backlink_pages.title: Component Map — Platform API
backlink_pages.author: Jordan Lee
backlink_pages.excerpt: Platform surface REST API, Webhooks, Workers, SDK, and Rate Limiting share auth middleware and request IDs. Failures often span two components—treat the map as a dependency graph, not a folder list.

backlink_pages.title: Data Retention Policy
backlink_pages.author: Jordan Lee
backlink_pages.excerpt: Policy summary Workspace data is retained for the life of the subscription plus thirty days. Worker job history is partitioned for cold storage; do not invent ad-hoc retention flags in product code.

backlink_pages.title: Observability Standards
backlink_pages.author: Jordan Lee
backlink_pages.excerpt: Tracing Webhook fan-out traces under NMA-170 use the shared trace context. Worker crashes when payloads contain nested null optional fields—see NMA-108—must include job type attributes on the span.

comments.author: Priya Sharma
comments.body: Post-rollout sample found zero unmasked emails in the checked windows.

content.text: Post-rollout sample found zero unmasked emails in the checked windows.
Worker debug logs occasionally include raw email addresses and phone numbers when jobs dump payloads on failure.
Ship a redaction policy that masks known PII field paths before debug logging and fails closed if a new field is marked sensitive without a rule.
Audit a week of sampled logs after rollout to confirm no unredacted matches remain.
